close_reason: Root cause identified and fixed: python-pptx >= 1.0 raises ValueError (not AttributeError) when accessing placeholder_format on non-placeholder shapes such as textboxes. The _read_pptx handler used getattr() which only catches AttributeError, so decks with textboxes crashed with HTTP 500. Fixed by wrapping placeholder_format access in a try/except that catches both ValueError and AttributeError. Regression test added in test_preview_pptx_with_textboxes.
